summary: The proof is complete. The section-length identity for g_E is correct, including x=0; all endpoint and tail sign implications are valid; the Omega lower bound cancels b+d correctly and contradicts the strict residual bound s>1 in every residual branch; the strict and boundary cases are covered; the automaton forces sigma_R in D from ell_R<0<u_R; and the Burnside calculations give 17464 removed systems per residual index, 52392 total, and 157512 surviving interior/interior systems.
